sup:70530.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €438.21 per unit, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 12 months, and Zahlungsziel 30 days net. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

Please note our cost context: CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 16 % of our cost. Additionally, PPI-C2611 rose 13.5 % in twelve months and is 42 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH: Frame agreement renewal for the 7.5 kW frequency converter
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We understand the cost pressures you describe; our binding volume commitment is set out immediately below, while the forecast that follows reflects our expected demand. We can offer a longer contract term to provide planning security; could you let us know which other terms may be adjusted?

We confirm a binding volume of 4580 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our bottom-up should-cost estimate for this part is EUR 403.21 per unit (cost:350020).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 412.74 (po:4500014465-10, po:4500014417-10, po:4500014351-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 10.3% (fc:350020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 419.78 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,
Thank you for your message.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €432.15 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a volume of 4580 pcs per year, a contract term of 36 months.
For your information:
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We checked the should cost data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
Our management has frozen all price reductions until December 2027. We can talk about the terms instead - payment, volume or contract length.
We welcome the 36-month contract term as it provides mutual planning security.
While we cannot accommodate 90 days for payment, we are willing to extend our terms to 60 days net.
In consideration of the longer contract and the 60-day payment term, we can reduce our price to EUR 432.15 per unit.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 60 days net: €430.68 per unit.
Our standard terms apply to everything the quote does not state; see attached.
This offer is subject to our general terms of sale.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Birgit Mayrhofer
Key Account Manager, Selvbrunn Drive Systems GmbH

move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
Thank you for moving on the terms, and we appreciate your willingness to consider a longer contract term. We understand that your management has frozen price reductions and that larger price steps require pricing committee approval. Our long-term proposal provides planning security, and we have moved toward you again in our proposal below.

Your on-time delivery was 84.6% in 2026Q3 (sc:70530@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 423.49 per unit, payment 90 days net, 36 months, 4580 units a year.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing
